lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible as multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots on the mid-lateral flank, with higher density and size in the central region between the primary and secondary carinae.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical columns of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the horizontal spot rows to create a semi-regular grid-like distribution across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal ridges are observed; the dorsal-most ridge is most prominent with a sharp intensity gradient transition from light pixels above to shadowed pixels below.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct cluster of high-luminance spots is visible on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin.
